question.text: Under the fit and proper criteria of the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008, which of the following persons must meet the criteria?

answer.text: Only the principal officer, directors, compliance officer, and key management persons
The applicant or intermediary itself; the principal officer, directors/managing partners, compliance officer and key management persons; and promoters or persons holding controlling interest
Only promoters or persons holding controlling interest
Only the applicant or the intermediary itself

explanation.text: The Logic: The fit and proper person criteria apply to the applicant or intermediary itself, the principal officer, directors/managing partners, compliance officer and key management persons, and promoters or persons holding controlling interest. All three groups must independently satisfy the criteria. The Trap: Each narrower option lists a real group covered by the criteria but only one slice of the full coverage. The regulation extends fit-and-proper testing to the entity, its key individuals, and its controlling persons together. Note: Rewrote the keyed option as a standalone enumerated list (no "All of the above") so the question remains correct under answer randomization, and removed the cross-exam and pro-tip paragraphs.
